thread:
ellie: Heads-up — noticed `/kb/runtime/model-onboarding` shortlink redirects to a 404 on staging. Found it while trying to validate a tutorial. Link: https://internal.kb/redwood/runtime/model-onboarding (404)
omar: ack — thanks for flagging. Do you know which doc used that shortlink?
ellie: It looks like the quickstart snippet `runtime/getting-started.md` references it. Small patch, but want to confirm owner before sending a PR.
ben: I eyeballed that file earlier — I think @lee touched the onboarding pieces last month.
lee: yep that was me. I can take ownership of the shortlink fix. Do you want a redirect to the new path or update the snippet to the canonical URL?
ellie: Redirect would be ideal to keep old bookmarks working, but a direct snippet update is fine if redirect is a pain.
docs-bot: link-scan: found 1 broken shortlink in /runtime/getting-started.md (line ~72). Suggested action: redirect OR update reference.
omar: If you can do a redirect that's low-effort. If not, update snippet + add a quick note in the PR description about the CRO (change of route).
lee: I'll open a tiny PR to add a 301 redirect entry to the link table AND update the snippet as a belt-and-suspenders approach. Will ping for review.
ben: thanks. @ellie can you add the exact failing curl output to the PR so QA can reproduce? e.g., `curl -I https://internal.kb/redwood/runtime/model-onboarding` and paste the 404 headers.
ellie: sure — will paste the headers and the failing client-side stack trace from the tutorial run.
omar: Heads-up for reviewers: this is safe to batch into docs small-fixes; no runtime change. @eng-docs-reviewers please take a look when lee opens the PR.
lee: PR opened: https://gh.redwood/repo/docs/pulls/5121 — includes redirect and snippet update. Small commit messages and tests.
ben: acked, reviewing now. Quick nits: update the redirect entry comment to include original publish date and a short reason.
lee: good call, adding that now.
ellie: verified staging after the PR patch — redirect works and tutorial builds without the 404. Thanks everyone.
ben: LGTM, approved. cc @omar for final merge when green.
omar: merging once CI passes. Nice fast turnaround :thumbsup:
lee: cheers! I'll add myself to the owner rotation for onboarding docs for the next 2 weeks so follow-ups are easier.
elie: great, thanks lee.
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs site rebuild queued (PR 5121). Estimated time ~3m.
lee: will monitor and post here if anything unexpected pops up.
ellie: all green on staging, closing loop here. If anyone sees other orphan shortlinks ping me and I'll triage.
ben: noted. I'll run a quick grep across the repo for similar shortlinks and open issues for anything else I find.
omar: thanks team — nice async flow
